views.rationale: AMZN's 9% sales growth in Q1 2023 outpaced BAC's 1% decline in sales and trading revenue
BA's Commercial Airplanes segment revenues increased 60% YoY, more than CAT's 17% increase in total sales and revenues
CVX's sales and other operating revenues decreased 7% YoY due to lower commodity prices
GOOGL's 3% revenue growth outpaces GS's 5% decline in net revenues
KO's 5% net operating revenue growth rate exceeds LIN's 16% segment operating profit growth rate
JNJ's 9.7% sales growth in the US outpaces JPM's 52% net income growth rate

NVDA's compute & networking segment gross margin increased 1.3% pts q/q, driven by higher margins and increased contribution from compute products, while MSFT's gross margin decreased 9% y/y due to a decline in Windows.
NEE's operating revenues increased $3.592 billion, primarily due to the impact of non-qualifying commodity hedges, while PG's net sales increased only 1% y/y.
